Results.ReviewText: Had this grill a short time but have used it already 6 times. Easy to use,  bbq comes out great every time .
Results.Title: Great size and love ash basket

Results.ReviewText: Finally a great grill that doesn't need gas!  The color is beautiful but that's just the extra perk!  The  22" size is perfect.  Initially I thought it might be too small.  Love the place for the lid "tuck away lid holder"!  Now we don't have to lay it on the ground!  Warmer rack is the perfect size.  Easy to assemble and the thermostat is nice to have on a charcoal grill!
Results.Title: Best Charcoal Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Very well built. First Weber used it yesterday to learn it. I was happy.
Results.Title: First time using Weber will not be last.

Results.ReviewText: I love everything about this grill, especially the color. Works great!
Results.Title: Get it, you won't regret it.

Results.ReviewText: Love the indirect grill baskets for tri-tip roast and chicken.
Results.Title: Master-Touch Charcoal Grill 22"

Results.ReviewText: All said it's okay. Fairly simply to use and there are numerous accessories. Would have given it 5 stars, however it leaks air around the top and bottom. I have put a gasket on it and hope this will correct the issue.
Results.Title: Weber Master Touch 22"

Results.ReviewText: The weber Master-Touch Charcoal Grill 22" is an excellent piece of grilling equipment. With the roll back lid and 7mm cooking grate plus the accessories available with the Gourmet BBQ System gives you many options for any grilling task. If given a choice, have it assembled by your local H/W store, attaching the legs can be tricky. Mine was a surprise gift at Christmas so my adult son supplied the extra muscle when needed to properly assemble it.  This grill is an addition to my fleet of weber products already in use, Natural gas Genesis EP-330, 14” Smoky Mountain, and 18” Weber kettle Gold. The best part about a Weber Grill of any kind is performance and ease of maintenance and the availability of spare parts when needed. A properly maintained Weber product will provide the same performance after some 10-20 years of use as it did on day one.
Results.Title: Master-Touch Charcoal Grill 22"

Results.ReviewText: The bbq flavor & grilling is amazing.  One of the most versatile grills in my arsenal of grills. I fell in love with grilling 25yrs ago and for many of those years only used my genesis (gas) out of convenience, which I still have.  Wish I made the move to charcoal long ago.  Spend the few extra bucks to get the master touch.  I own 3 Weber grills and they never fail to deliver quality home food/bbq.
Results.Title: Top Notch Charcoal Grill

Photos.Caption: Weber charcoal with Weber gas - December 31, 2021
Old Weber charcoal still in use!

Results.ReviewText:
This charcoal grill is replacing my previous Weber charcoal grill that I've had for 20 years. There are several improvements with this one over my old Weber... I love the built-in lid holder. This is what OLD Weber charcoal grills used to have. They also had wood handles, but I guess this won't be coming back ;-)

It's also nice having the built in thermometer and assorted grill options - stone pizza plate, cast iron searing grate, etc. I also have a gas Weber that's used almost daily.

Over the years I've had exceptional service from Weber when new parts are needed. I truly have no reason to even consider other brands when it comes time to. We also have a vintage Weber charcoal  with rotisserie kit at the cottage, pic attached.
Results.Title: Nothing is better than Weber!

Results.ReviewText: My wife gave it to me for Christmas, and I love it! I already smoked some ribs and deer in it. It can do it all. I recommend it. Excellent product!
Results.Title: Best grill

Results.ReviewText: I love it. I have a smoker and wanted something for hot and fast cooks. Super excited too learn all the things this grill can do.
Results.Title: Getting back to the basics

Results.ReviewText: I ordered the grill because I wanted a choice in colors.  Love everything else that comes with it.
Results.Title: GREAT GRILL!

Results.ReviewText:
Like the grill, very efficient with the coals and fairly easy to dial in and maintain temps. Able to  get great smoke out of it and using 1/3 of the coals my cheap grill had to use.

My unit shipped missing the handle for the upper vent and the warming rack, QC needs to be better but the weber was quick to ship out my missing pieces.

Dont like the grill/grate, they need to rethink that design so the center can be locked in. there should be several ways to do that and still leave the ability to remove when desired,  but its difficult to even scrub the grate without it falling out and forget hanging it on the the edge of the bbq while setting up your coals

And the grate is much more difficult to clean then the grate that was on my cheap grill
Results.Title: love the BBQ, but the grate needs resigned

Results.ReviewText: I cooked the best turkey for Christmas that have ever cooked
Results.Title: The best Turkey

Results.ReviewText: Très heureux de mon achat  fait de tous avec cuire ou fumer
Results.Title: Peut toute faire avec se Master-touch

Results.ReviewText: All I can say is this grill makes incredible food.  Temp control is very easy to maintain as well.  I have a 26" already and added this to my arsenal.  With a slow n sear there is more room than I was expecting.  Couldn't be happier with my purchase.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Cela fait 3 fois que j'en depuis le 26 décembre et c'est  délicieux à chaque occasion.
Results.Title: Très satisfait

Results.ReviewText: I’m a Weber guy, so of coarse I am going to appreciate my new Weber.  That said, the installation of the shoot that holds the ash collector that attaches to the kettle was difficult and a bit flimsy.  I was able to install but added rivets to the shoot flaps that went through each leg.  Now the shoot is very sturdy.  I have the rotisserie unit from my old 22” Weber and used it to roast two Cornish Game Hens on the new Master Touch and everything worked great and tasted delicious.
Results.Title: New Master Touch 22” Kettle

We are very sorry to learn of your disappointment with the accessories. We appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback with our team regarding the addition of stainless steel grates. Weber is constantly working on ways to improve our products and our customer experience and we are happy to pass your suggestions along. ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText:
Overall this is a nice grill.  I mainly bought this one because it's taller than other 22 inch grills, although it took me quite a while to figure out the differences between all the Weber charcoal grills.  Why is it that I have to find videos on YouTube etc. to explain the differences between the different levels of Weber charcoal grills?  You'd think a company like Weber would shoot a nice (short) video explaining the differences clearly.  Apparently that's too much to ask.  Furthermore, I'd much prefer a stainless steel grate for this grill rather than some of the gimmicks/accessories like the charcoal baskets and warming rack.  I'd argue the charcoal baskets are obsolete if you are familiar with the charcoal snake method.  Is anyone really going to use the warming rack?  I won't.  
Having the center of the grill grate removable makes it impossible to put the rack in any position other than flat.  Very annoying when you just want to put it down.  
Overall, nice grill.  Get rid of the gimmicks and make it quality throughout.  Rather than try to include a bunch of accessories that may or may not get used.
Results.Title: Gimmick Grill

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love this grill. Glad to see some companies are still selling quality products!
Results.Title: master touch 22"

Results.ReviewText: As always, great product. There is no better! This is my 6th Weber in my collection. They all have there own purpose!
Results.Title: Another great grill!

Results.ReviewText: My Ocean Blue Master Touch BBQ grill is awesome. The open lid feature is very convenient and overall it is just a great BBQ with its' many features - the warming rack, the tool rack, and the middle portion of the grilling great makes it easy to prepare any side dishes with the wok.
Results.Title: Lovin' my Master Touch!

Results.ReviewText: cover vent handle melted off first time I used the grill.
Results.Title: Bad engineering design on grill cover vent.

Results.ReviewText: Great cooker but Weber could have beefed up the size of the tubing for the legs(wall thickness). Not very stable when moving around, wall thickness on tubing seems barely thicker than tin foil- very flimsy design.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill but very flimsy legs

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback with our team regarding the Master Touch grill. We are so sorry to learn you had to sand down one of the plastic parts and the imperfections inside the the grill. This is not the quality we come to expect from our products. One of our team members has reached out via email to assist you further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Photos.Caption: Hole is higher than what I believe it should be
Hole is in what I assume is the correct location

Results.ReviewText: I just got my deep ocean blue mastertouch yesterday and assembly was not that bad. One of the holes for the lid holder was drilled higher than the other and I ended up having to sand one of the plastic pieces down so it would go under the lip of the grill. There are also a bunch of imperfections on the inside and some on the outside which is not what I expect for the price I paid and the Weber name. The color is also not exactly what I expected. It's more of a Ford blue than a darker blue that is shown on the package. This is the second kettle I've had in the past 12 years and this on isn't terrible but I can tell a quality difference in this on and my old one.
Results.Title: Quality is not as good as it used to be

Results.ReviewText: Love the built in thermometer, and the new design ash chatcher.
Results.Title: 22” grill

Results.ReviewText: I am so happy about my New grill. Even in the snow i used it 3 times this week. Smoke smoke smoke
Results.Title: Happy

Results.ReviewText: It's a nice grill, I would like to see a thermometer just below the vent though. I'll probably be adding one there myself. The top vent must have some sharp edges on it as it was slightly scratching my top when opening or closing. The vent is pretty snug against the lid.
Results.Title: Nice Grill for the price

Results.ReviewText: Classic grilling and is my go to for smoking and controlled grilling.
Results.Title: Classic grilling and smoking

Results.ReviewText:
If I was rating this on assembly alone, I would have given it a 2-star rating. Two of the three legs were too wide and were being grinded against the kettle body. It didn't even work so I had to hammer the edge of the legs to taper them; the third leg, however, went in with the amount of resistance I expected.

The blade apparatus on the bottom also is not flush with the ashcatcher, so ash will fall below the kettle quite often. This is a minor gripe as the catcher does catch about 99% of the ash; it's more of an annoyance.

Outside of that, the grill performs as expected. For this model, when you hang the cover, it awkwardly covers about 1/4 of it from my vantage point; this may or may not be a big deal depending on your height. I would have liked the lid to be totally out of the way, but I guess that angle has its advantages.

The included char baskets were a bit small for my liking, but maybe that's something I can work around with different types of charcoal. I end up not using them most of the time and just making a pile where the baskets would be instead.
Results.Title: Great once assembled

Results.ReviewText: I dont know what I was expecting for the price, but this thing blew me away! My best purchase in a long time.
Results.Title: Fantastic grill

Results.ReviewText: Good Grill for a family of 4-6 people. We love it!!
Results.Title: Master touch 22”

Results.ReviewText: I bought my master touch 3 weeks and it is so fun to use,  we find ourselves rediscovering the pleasures of bbq
Results.Title: Fun

Results.ReviewText: It has everything one needs for 2-zone grilling and smoking.  Top quality materials and build.  Easy to use, clean and maintain.  Excellent ash removal system.  Great customer service.  Huge variety of after market add-ons.  Can't beat a Weber for charcoal grilling.
Results.Title: Weber...all you need.

Results.ReviewText: I've been grilling since the 80s with my dad on our first Weber gas grill, and then I got a basic Kettle Charcoal Grill in college, and loved it. But recently, I treated myself to this master Touch, and it's a no-brainer. This is easily worth every penny of the upcharge, and the features are magnificent. I love my new master Touch Grill.
Results.Title: Worth every penny

Results.ReviewText: Love this 22” kettle. Heavy duty grill grate with openings for charcoal plus more accessories. I do vortex wing grilling and the center opening is perfect.
Results.Title: Weber Master Touch

Results.ReviewText: The build quality on the legs is really poor, but the grill itself is great!
Results.Title: Master-Touch Review

Results.ReviewText: Acheter au début de l’été et j’en ai vraiment profité, super cuisson et fumage de côte levé
Results.Title: Super machine

Results.ReviewText:
It’s a new learning experience.  Yr other-char dome much easier n less complicated. That’s the one I’ve been using forever. 
Easier cleanup as well. Thx guys yr the best.
Results.Title: Great quality, a bit too much work.

Results.ReviewText: Nice product. Assembly was not easy because legs were too tight of fit to kettle. Frustrating!
Results.Title: Webber

14510601.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14510601.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
